meta.title: 4growth — Modular Smart Farm A-Block · DLight · AI Farm OS
meta.description: We solve problems found in the field with hardware and software. A-Block modular smart farm, DLight DLI-based LED control, and AI Farm OS cultivation data platform.

hero.title: Designing sustainable agriculture through technology
hero.label: Technology for Sustainable Agriculture
hero.body: We solve problems found in the field with hardware and software.

field.title: Our technology starts in the field, not at a desk
field.body: 4growth has grown and distributed crops directly in the field. More than four years of growing and shipping experience, built through floriculture and distribution partnerships, sets the standard for the technology we make. Which data to measure, and which automation is truly needed, can only be learned by facing the field again and again.

stack.title: Three technologies that make one farm
stack.body: Growing space, light control, operational data. These are not separate products but one system that makes up a farm.

aBlock.headline: Build as much as you need. Move it where you need it.
aBlock.body: A-Block is a semi-open modular growing unit built from an aluminum profile frame and polycarbonate panels. It can be assembled and disassembled on site, and expands module by module as scale requires. Sensors and controls are built into each module, so the growing environment can be managed without separate facility construction.

points.title: Semi-open design
points.desc: Uses natural light, saving energy compared with closed systems

aBlock.structure: Light sensor · Aluminum profile frame · LED lighting · Polycarbonate panels (semi-open) · Growing trays & piping · Control unit (sensors & control)

dlight.headline: Plants don't need light all the time. They need just the right amount.
dlight.body: Every crop needs a different Daily Light Integral (DLI). Fixed timers run LEDs for the same hours even on sunny days. DLight measures incoming natural light in real time and uses LEDs to supply only what is missing from the target.
dlight.summary: LEDs supply only what's missing from the target
dlight.status: In development · Field validation in progress

farmOs.headline: One farm, one system
farmOs.body: Environmental data from sensors and cultivation records come together in AI Farm OS. Monitor the environment, manage light, control devices and review cultivation history on one screen, and generate cultivation reports automatically from accumulated data.

rnd.title: We combine technology transfer with in-house development.

business.title: The same technology extends to different fields.
business.body: A-Block · DLight · AI Farm OS are configured differently by scale and purpose.
